run_get_version_describe: run the python module to resolve and print the correct setuptools-scm version tag for the current git commit
run_get_latest_version_tag: run the python module with --tag-only to print just the highest version tag sorted by PEP 440 ordering
test_parse_version_tuple: test the parse_version_tuple function to verify PEP 440 sorting of version tags with rc and post suffixes
test_get_exact_version_tag: test the get_exact_version_tag function to check if the current HEAD commit has an exact version tag
test_get_latest_version_tag_describe: test the get_latest_version_tag_describe function to build a describe string for untagged commits relative to the latest tag
